title: CNSS Skill D carry-balanced acquisition control
objective: Test whether balancing the frequency of existing carry-event strata improves held-out modular-addition acquisition without changing unique training support, model capacity, optimizer or test states.

design.control_arm: existing rank-32 lambda-0.1 2,000-update rows, three seeds
design.balanced_arm: same seed-specific step-0 adapter states and same 128-state candidate support, with each deterministic 128-draw epoch sampled with replacement to carry-event quotas [15,15,14,14,14,14,14,14,14] for carry counts 0 through 8

held_constant: same validation and fixed 64-state test partitions
preflight_requirements: balanced sampler draws only from existing training states
balanced pool has no validation or test overlap
balanced quotas are deterministic and exact
baseline step-0 checkpoints are finite and hash-verified
primary_measurements: training, validation and held-out exact accuracy
accuracy by carry-event count, chain length and wraparound
success_gate: Balanced training must improve held-out accuracy over the paired existing control without reducing training integrity; the 95% individual D gate remains unchanged.
interpretation_rule: A positive result would support a curriculum-frequency effect under the fixed workspace; it would not establish a carry algorithm or unlock composition by itself.
